{"relevant": true, "severity": "critical", "message": "internal/httpx/logging.go logs all headers and full request bodies to stdout. That writes Authorization/Cookie/API-key headers and body fields like passwords and tokens into logs in plaintext, so anyone with log access (or a log aggregator) can replay sessions or harvest credentials. Fix: log only method, path, status and latency plus a request ID; use a header allowlist (e.g. User-Agent, Content-Type) rather than dumping all; redact Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie and X-API-Key; do not log bodies by default (if needed, gate behind a debug flag, cap size, and mask sensitive fields). Also consume the body safely (restore it via io.NopCloser) and sanitize or escape the path and values to prevent log injection via newlines."}
